handle.representation: a zero-sized Copy struct with a private constructor (Appendix C.1)
handle.ownership: carries no state, so a copy is the capability itself; a future that holds one owns it and may be detached
handle.created_by: Host.capabilities(), called once by main (11.6); every other handle of this type is derived from that one

ownership.task: the Task, moved: its join obligation transfers to the supervisor exactly once (a second detach is refused statically, E-OWN-020)
ownership.supervisor: the handle by value (a Copy handle: copied, never consumed)

Scope.detach.allocation: none for the transfer; the detached task's future was boxed at launch, since it owns what it holds and may outlive its scope
Scope.detach.cancellation: the detached task is no longer cancelled by its scope's exit; the transfer itself is not a cancellation point

ownership.tasks: every detached task, owned by the executor until it completes

program end.allocation: none beyond the records: each task's future is dropped when it completes
program end.cancellation: the main task waits for each detached task in detach order and resumes first when the one it waits for completes; nothing cancels the wait, and a defect in a detached task ends the process (10.8)

waiting.states: suspend main, the detached tasks run in detach order, resume main after each completes

violation.clause: a task's join obligation transfers once
